title: Why Can Tabs Stay On
coreQuestion: Why does a drink can's tab stay attached after you open it?

facts.claim: Early pull-tabs came off the can and became a common form of litter.
Daniel F. Cudzik of Reynolds Metals developed the stay-on tab in 1975.

narration.text: Why does a can's tab stay attached after you open it?
Early can tabs came right off.
Those loose tabs became a common form of litter.
In 1975, Daniel Cudzik of Reynolds Metals developed a tab that stays on.
The tab stays with the can so it never ends up on the ground.
